text:
Ava CSM: hey team :wave: kicking off an activation scheduler for NimbleFin this week. want to align enablement, risk triage, and feedback capture before we flip them to prod. who can own enrollment coordination, and who will own the feedback loop?

Jorge Support: I can take post-enroll support + runbook updates. any SSO/cert gotchas we should pre-check?

Lily SE: I'll own enablement and workspace setup. can someone confirm they can get SSO test creds from NimbleFin by EOD Wed? i'll also run a perf baseline once we have test tokens.

Kai PM: i'll track renewal-risk signals and usage ramp. current quick snapshot from the analytics job: `daily_active_calls: 12`, `target_onboard_calls: 150` — low signal so far, flagging for closer follow-up.

Ava CSM: perfect. proposed schedule:
```
Thu 09:30 - Enablement + SSO smoke test (Lily)
Thu 11:00 - Support runbook walkthrough (Jorge)
Thu 14:00 - Feedback form review & rollout plan (Kai)
Fri 10:00 - Internal risk triage + go/no-go
```
Can folks confirm availability for those slots?

CalendarBot: invite sent to team for Thu 09:30 and Thu 11:00. agenda attached. :calendar:

Ava CSM: recap of action items so we don't lose this thread: 1) Lily -> request SSO test creds & perform baseline; 2) Jorge -> update runbook + add escalation steps; 3) Kai -> lightweight feedback form + define renewal signal thresholds; 4) Ava -> own go/no-go and customer communications. please reply with ✅ when done.

Jorge Support: noted. opening a runbook PR now — https://git.redwood.internal/runbooks/nimblefin-onboard (will add checklist and three escalation playbooks).

Lily SE: pinged customer contact for SSO creds just now, ETA EOD Wed. i'll drop baseline numbers in this thread once complete. :thumbsup:

Kai PM: building the feedback form (short 5 q) and will post draft by lunchtime Thu. thinking about a simple NPS + two freeform fields for friction + feature asks.

Ava CSM: awesome. low risk ask — if anyone sees the usage jump after enablement, call it out here so we can shift renewal outreach earlier.

Jorge Support: will monitor support queue and add a dashboard alert for spikes.

Lily SE: confirmed for Thu 09:30.

Kai PM: confirmed for Thu 14:00.

Ava CSM: thanks all. leaving this open for updates — i'll post the go/no-go note after Fri 10:00 triage.

CalendarBot: reminder scheduled: Thu 30m before each session.
